text_en: Take off the garment of your sorrow and affliction, O Jerusalem, and put on forever the beauty of the glory from God.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷！请你脱去你居丧悲伤的衣裳，永远穿上天主光荣的华服，

text_en: Put on the robe of the righteousness that comes from God; put on your head the diadem of the glory of the Everlasting;
text_cn: 披上天主正义的披肩，在你头上戴上永生者光荣的冠冕，

text_en: for God will show your splendor everywhere under heaven.
text_cn: 因为天主要对天下万邦显示你的荣耀，

text_en: For God will give you evermore the name, “Righteous Peace, Godly Glory. ”
text_cn: 给你起名永远叫“正义的和平”，和“虔敬的光荣”。

text_en: Arise, O Jerusalem, stand upon the height; look toward the east, and see your children gathered from west and east at the word of the Holy One, rejoicing that God has remembered them.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷！请你起来，站在高处，向东远眺，看，你的子女奉圣者的命，由西方至东方集合，喜庆天主终于想起了他们。

text_en: For they went out from you on foot, led away by their enemies; but God will bring them back to you, carried in glory, as on a royal throne.
text_cn: 他们离你远去，由仇人押送步行；如今天主却将他们给你再领回来；他们体面光荣，被人抬回，好像皇子一样；

text_en: For God has ordered that every high mountain and the everlasting hills be made low and the valleys filled up, to make level ground, so that Israel may walk safely in the glory of God.
text_cn: 因为天主已命令夷平一切的高山和永恒的丘陵，填平所有的山谷，使它们化为平地，好让以色列在天主的光荣下平安前行；

text_en: The woods and every fragrant tree have shaded Israel at God’s command.
text_cn: 森林和一切香树要依照天主的命令，给以色列散布荫凉；

text_en: For God will lead Israel with joy, in the light of his glory, with the mercy and righteousness that come from him.
text_cn: 因为天主要在喜乐中，以自己本有的仁慈和正义，在自己荣耀的光辉下，亲自领回以色列。
